episodes.title: A Girl Named Mary Saotome
episodes.synopsis: Lacking in gambling skills, Tsuzura Hanatemari finds herself at the bottom of the food chain - until one day, an old friend transfers into the academy. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: A Targeted Girl
episodes.synopsis: Student Council member Sakura Miharutaki faces off against a gamble-crazed, unruly student. Mary's scheme backfires when an unexpected guest shows up. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: A Tratorious Girl
episodes.synopsis: On the brink of becoming a house pet, Mary must find a way to earn money. Trust is on the line when she and her friends attend a "coupling party". (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Confessing Girls
episodes.synopsis: With a traitor in their midst, Mary struggles with trusting her friends. Meanwhile, the opposing boys' team argues over whether to rejoin the game. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: An Honest Girl
episodes.synopsis: Aoi attempts to lure Mary into his Full-Bloom Society. Joining forces with Mikura, Sakura plots to undermine Mary through a gambling match. (Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: A Resisting Girl
episodes.synopsis: Sakura and Mary brace themselves for the final game. In desperation, Mary asks her friends for help, using whatever means necessary to win. (Source: Netflix)
